title: bug: protected standalone moe-call.sh direct execution runs a project bash through its env shebang before PATH scrubbing
description:
Adversarial review of task-0b2ea570: moe-call.sh still starts with #!/usr/bin/env bash. From a scratch project containing executable ./bash, direct exec with MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 and PATH=.:/usr/bin:/bin runs that plant before the script body (exit 42, ran.log='project bash').
Reproduced on the final task worktree bytes; fixture at /mnt/d/moe-scratch/0b2ea570-work/residuals-xhs0e985. Current approved M2 rows invoke /bin/bash explicitly and cannot cover kernel/env interpreter selection.
Keep this separate from the approved PATH-body scrub; add direct-exec coverage and define a trusted interpreter entry path without changing legacy behavior.
definitionOfDone: Under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1, supported direct invocation cannot select a project bash before the helper body; add a non-vacuous planted-bash regression.
Preserve supported Linux/macOS/Git Bash entry behavior and legacy compatibility; document any direct-invocation limitation.
reopenReason: Governor promotion, 06:35Z: its dependency 0b2ea570 is DONE, it has a precise repro (env-shebang project-bash plant under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1), and the planning queue is empty with the architect idle.
